image_description: A low-angle shot of a skateboarder performing a trick (grind or slide) on the handrail of an outdoor concrete staircase. The bannister is a black metal tubular railing supported by vertical posts. In the background, there are trees and a park-like setting. A watermark 'errorism' is visible in the bottom left corner.
